description: Inside at last. Curator Vess wants to show you the Spire the way the Ascendants show it to the promising: the ladder in the Gallery, a resurrection in the Vats, and whatever waits at the top. Walk it, and learn what Halcyon has really been selling.
name: Assurance for the Assured

emotes: {who} walks the lit vitrines from crude jack to cortical backup, and feels the exhibit doing its quiet work.

objectives.desc: Witness a policy payout in the Vats
emotes: {who} watches a tank drain and a backed-up client sit up, blinking, alive on a paid account.
{who} rides to the crown of the Spire, where the seal waits — the same calm eye that watches every Halcyon claim.
